messages:
Andrea: Anyone seeing a spike in AWQ serving errors after yesterday's model swap? prod Llama2-13B-awq with group_size=64 hit canary and we started getting truncated responses and higher decode error rates.

Sam: Yep, saw it. p95 token latency +120ms, error rate ~1.8% (was 0.2%). Repro locally with batcher logs.

Sam: ```
[2026-03-18T09:12:03Z] decode_error: token-drop
[2026-03-18T09:12:03Z] p95_latency_ms: 312 -> 435
[2026-03-18T09:12:03Z] kv_cache_miss_rate: 0.04
```

ops-bot: Canary deployment (llama2-13b-awq-v2) scaled down from 10% -> 0% due to threshold breach :warning:

Jia: Quick hypothesis: enabling activation-quant (act_quant=true) at group_size=64 increases activation clipping for longer contexts, producing unstable decodes. We saw similar signal in sim but lower magnitude.

Mike: I reran a small repro: group_size=32 + act_quant=false => stable. group_size=64 + act_quant=false still had mild token-drop. So group_size is a strong factor.

Sasha: Proposed experiment plan: controlled offline sweep across quant strategies: FP8 baseline, GPTQ 8-bit, AWQ group_size [16,32,64] × act_quant [true,false]. Keep seed, ctx=512, batcher mimic prod. I can spin up the runner today.

Andrea: Plan: rollback canary to previous variant (v1) now, run offline 3-sweep (16/32/64) with actq on/off. Gating thresholds: NLL delta < 0.15, token-drop < 0.1%, decode error rate < 0.25%. If passed, reintroduce 5% canary with extra tracing.

Sam: I'll add extra traces for prefix cache usage and batcher group boundaries. My hunch: when group_size grows, batcher boundaries misalign with KV-cache segments causing partial cache invalidation.

Sam: Quick config snippet I'm going to try in repro:

```
awq_config:
  group_size: 32
  act_quant: false
  per_channel_scale: true
  cache_alignment: 64
```

Sasha: I'll run the bake-off and attach eval summary (NLL, BLEU-like, response-length stability) to the thread. Will also include a small prompt set that mimics multi-turn dialogs.

Andrea: Also add routing fallback: if variant error_rate >0.5% over 1m, route to v1 automatically. Add a temporary flag to block auto-rollout until we finish the sweep. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident note: canary rolled back by Andrea. Incident auto-closed. :white_check_mark:

Mike: assigning: Sam -> tracing + infra repro; Sasha -> offline sweeps and results table; Jia -> failure-mode analysis; I'll help with deployment gating.

Andrea: Thanks all. Let's sync on results in the 30-min sync or update here. :eyes:
